deployments_detail.use: Polyphonic AI surgery platform (NVIDIA) + AI drug discovery (CIO: ~50% faster lead generation); pivoted from 900 GenAI use cases to prioritized set

AI-based drug design and generative molecular modeling used to identify starting points and optimize molecules into drug candidates; J&J says AI is halving the time it takes to generate new leads for developing drugs.
deployments_detail.value: AI halves time to generate new drug-development leads

deployments_detail.use: MONARCH Platform for robotic-assisted bronchoscopy uses AI-powered algorithms for airway navigation and image processing; MONARCH Quest received FDA clearance in March 2025 and is commercially deployed.

VELYS Robotic-Assisted Solution for total knee arthroplasty uses AI-driven software, an infrared camera and optical trackers to calculate implant placement and balance the knee, guiding precise total and partial knee replacement. Commercially deployed via DePuy Synthes.
VELYS Hip Navigation with AI Assistance for total hip arthroplasty, providing AI-based landmark identification to support intraoperative consistency and efficiency; launched by DePuy Synthes.

Collaboration with NVIDIA to scale AI for surgery, using NVIDIA technology to accelerate secure, real-time analysis of surgical data at the edge within J&J MedTech's connected digital ecosystem for surgery (Polyphonic). [NVIDIA]

Privacy-preserving federated learning collaboration (with AbbVie via Apheris/AISB) contributing proprietary molecular data to train the OpenFold3 model for predicting biomolecular structures relevant to drug discovery, such as small molecule-protein and antibody-antigen interactions. [Apheris / OpenFold3]
AI Fund for surgical innovation and data-driven healthcare
AI-based drug design and generative modeling
GenAI for drug development and supply chain risk mitigation
Named as a Microsoft Copilot customer/case study [Microsoft Copilot] [Microsoft Copilot]
Enterprise generative-AI internal chatbot that answers employee HR, benefits and policy questions, automating millions of annual employee service queries and reducing burden on support staff.

Intelligent Supply Chain Risk Management system using predictive analytics and AI to detect, anticipate and mitigate supply chain disruptions and optimize inventory; retained as a high-value use case after the AI strategy pivot.

AI/ML-powered employee skills inference platform that infers workforce skills from internal data to drive personalized career development, mentoring recommendations and strategic workforce planning across J&J's global workforce (documented in an MIT CISR case study).
Use of Google Cloud machine learning (Cloud Talent Solution) to transform J&J's recruitment process by improving job search relevance and candidate-to-role matching. [Google Cloud]
GenAI deployment in Control Tower for supply chain planning, procurement, and manufacturing
AI for supply chain optimization and resilience

Rep Copilot: a generative-AI copilot that coaches pharmaceutical sales representatives in real time on how to engage healthcare professionals about products, surfacing validated product and customer information. Cited by J&J CIO as one of the highest-value GenAI use cases retained after the strategy pivot.
